verdict.rationale: Canny has 'Autopilot' which automatically captures feedback from sources like Gong, Intercom, Slack, and routes conversations without manual intervention, suggesting some background automation exists, but there's no documented evidence of user-configurable autonomous automations/workflows running independently. missing for 10: explicit automation/workflow builder documentation, evidence of scheduled or trigger-based autonomous runs, independent confirmation of Autopilot's autonomy, and details on customizing or monitoring these background processes.
